# io.systemd.Hostname

APIs for querying and changing the system hostname and related machine metadata.

## Methods

### Describe

Returns hostname, kernel, OS, hardware, firmware and other machine metadata in one call.

```go
func (c *Client) Describe(ctx context.Context, in DescribeIn) (*DescribeOut, error)
```

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allowInteractiveAuthentication` | `?bool` | Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. |

**Reply**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Hostname` | `string` | The current system hostname. |
| `StaticHostname` | `?string` | The statically configured hostname, from /etc/hostname. Null if none is configured. |
| `PrettyHostname` | `?string` | The pretty (free-form, UTF-8) hostname. Null if none is configured. |
| `DefaultHostname` | `?string` | The fallback hostname used when neither a static nor a transient hostname is set. |
| `HostnameSource` | `string` | Indicates where the current hostname originates from, one of 'static', 'transient' or 'default'. |
| `IconName` | `?string` | The name of an icon representing this system, following the XDG icon naming spec. Null if none is configured. |
| `Chassis` | `?string` | The chassis type of this system, e.g. 'desktop', 'laptop', 'server', 'vm', … Null if unknown. |
| `ChassisAssetTag` | `?string` | An unique identifier of the system chassis. |
| `Deployment` | `?string` | The deployment environment of this system, e.g. 'production' or 'staging'. Null if none is configured. |
| `Location` | `?string` | A human-readable description of the physical location of this system. Null if none is configured. |
| `KernelName` | `string` | The operating system kernel name, as reported by uname(2), e.g. 'Linux'. |
| `KernelRelease` | `string` | The kernel release string, as reported by uname(2). |
| `KernelVersion` | `string` | The kernel version string, as reported by uname(2). |
| `OperatingSystemPrettyName` | `?string` | 'Pretty' name of the OS. This is the primary OS identifier that is suitable for presentation to the user. Typically includes a version too, but doesn't have to. |
| `OperatingSystemFancyName` | `?string` | 'Fancy' name of the OS; may contain non-ASCII Unicode chars, as well as basic ANSI sequences. This is similar to 'OperatingSystemPrettyName', but is preferably used on terminals that support ANSI sequences and full Unicode. |
| `OperatingSystemCPEName` | `?string` | The CPE name of the OS, from the CPE_NAME= field of os-release. |
| `OperatingSystemHomeURL` | `?string` | The home URL of the OS, from the HOME_URL= field of os-release. |
| `OperatingSystemSupportEnd` | `?int` | The end-of-support time of the OS, in µs since the UNIX epoch. Null if not known. |
| `OperatingSystemReleaseData` | `?[]string` | The full contents of os-release, as an array of 'KEY=VALUE' strings. |
| `OperatingSystemImageID` | `?string` | The OS image identifier, from the IMAGE_ID= field of os-release. |
| `OperatingSystemImageVersion` | `?string` | The OS image version, from the IMAGE_VERSION= field of os-release. |
| `MachineInformationData` | `?[]string` | The full contents of /etc/machine-info, as an array of 'KEY=VALUE' strings. |
| `MachineTags` | `?[]string` | The machine tags, from the TAGS= field of /etc/machine-info with any invalid tags filtered out. Empty if none are configured. |
| `HardwareVendor` | `?string` | The hardware vendor of this system. Null if not known. |
| `HardwareModel` | `?string` | The hardware model of this system. Null if not known. |
| `HardwareSerial` | `?string` | The hardware serial number of this system. Reading it requires privileges. Null if not known. |
| `HardwareSKU` | `?string` | The hardware SKU (stock keeping unit) of this system. Null if not known. |
| `HardwareVersion` | `?string` | The hardware version of this system. Null if not known. |
| `FirmwareVersion` | `?string` | The firmware version of this system. Null if not known. |
| `FirmwareVendor` | `?string` | The firmware vendor of this system. Null if not known. |
| `FirmwareDate` | `?int` | The firmware build date, in µs since the UNIX epoch. Null if not known. |
| `MachineID` | `string` | The 128-bit machine ID of this system, formatted as a hexadecimal string. |
| `BootID` | `string` | The 128-bit boot ID of the current boot, formatted as a hexadecimal string. |
| `ProductUUID` | `?string` | The DMI product UUID of this system. Reading it requires privileges. Null if not known. |
| `VSockCID` | `?int` | The AF_VSOCK context ID (CID) of this system. Null if not known. |

### SetHostname

:material-new-box: since v262

Sets the transient (runtime) hostname.

```go
func (c *Client) SetHostname(ctx context.Context, in SetHostnameIn) error
```

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `newValue` | `?string` | The transient (runtime) hostname to set. If null the transient hostname is reset, so that the static hostname is used again. |
| `allowInteractiveAuthentication` | `?bool` | Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. |

### SetTags

:material-new-box: since v262

Edits the machine tag list: optionally resets it to 'set', then adds 'add' and removes 'remove'.

```go
func (c *Client) SetTags(ctx context.Context, in SetTagsIn) error
```

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `set` | `?[]string` | If specified, the machine tag list is first reset to exactly these tags, before the 'add' and 'remove' fields are applied. If null, the current tag list is used as basis instead. |
| `add` | `?[]string` | Machine tags to add to the list. |
| `remove` | `?[]string` | Machine tags to remove from the list. |
| `allowInteractiveAuthentication` | `?bool` | Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. |
